title: Self-Pay Visit Package Terms — Medical Freeze Entitlements by Tier
content:
**Section: medical freeze.** A Self-Pay Visit Package may be frozen for a documented medical reason only where its tier allows it. The entitlements of each tier are set out below.

| Tier | Freezing allowed | Maximum freeze length | Freezes per package | Physician or therapist note required | Unfreezing extends the expiry date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter 4-Visit Package | No | 0 calendar days | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Recovery 6-Visit Package | Yes | 30 calendar days | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Core 8-Visit Package | Yes | 30 calendar days | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Complete 12-Visit Package | Yes | 45 calendar days | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package | Yes | 60 calendar days | 2 | Yes | Yes |
| Comprehensive 24-Visit Package | Yes | 60 calendar days | 2 | Yes | Yes |

**Terms used in this section**

- *Freezing allowed* — whether the package may be frozen for a documented medical reason.
- *Maximum freeze length* — the maximum calendar days of one freeze; 0 where freezing is not allowed.
- *Freezes per package* — the maximum number of freezes on one package.
- *Note required* — whether a freeze needs a note from a physician or the treating therapist.
- *Unfreezing extends the expiry date* — whether unfreezing pushes the expiry date of the package out.

**Questions this section answers**

*Can a Starter 4-Visit Package be frozen?* No. Freezing is not allowed on that tier, its maximum freeze length is 0 calendar days and it has 0 freezes.

*How many times can a Comprehensive 24-Visit Package be frozen?* At most 2 times, the same as the Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package; the Recovery 6-Visit, Core 8-Visit and Complete 12-Visit Packages allow 1 freeze each.

*Is a medical note needed on every tier that allows a freeze?* Yes. Every tier requires a note from a physician or the treating therapist for a freeze.
